claims: Alex Bowman has been medically cleared to return to the No. 48 Hendrick Motorsports Chevrolet for the NASCAR Cup Series race at Bristol Motor Speedway.
Alex Bowman missed four races due to vertigo symptoms.
Alex Bowman completed simulator work and physical evaluations to confirm his recovery.
Alex Bowman's return race is Bristol Motor Speedway (Food City 500) on April 12, 2026.
Vertigo symptoms first forced Alex Bowman out of the car at Circuit of the Americas (COTA) on March 1.
Alex Bowman missed races at Phoenix, Las Vegas, Darlington, and Martinsville.
Justin Allgaier, Anthony Alfredo, and Myatt Snider filled in as substitute drivers during Alex Bowman's absence.
Alex Bowman expressed readiness to return after focusing on his recovery.
Hendrick Motorsports emphasized that Alex Bowman's health was the top priority before clearing him for competition
